rule: Only flights hoydedata.no publishes on the 0.25 m grid, because that is the grid the z16 base is built to read. Densest first, then outward from ground the store already holds, so the map fills as a region rather than as scattered patches. Overlap is not a reason to skip one: two flights over one landscape become two rows.

acquisitions.name: Gjerdrum 50pkt 2021
acquisitions.note: The densest flight in the country, and 29 km² of it. A day's work for the deepest ground the cache can hold.

acquisitions.name: Trondheim 30pkt 2020
acquisitions.note: Under the 2022 flight almost entirely. Two years apart at the same density: the pair that shows what a second row is for.

acquisitions.name: Vestfold 10pkt 2025
acquisitions.note: Twice the density of the ground already in the store and on top of it. The first acquisition this store holds two of.

acquisitions.name: Grenland Vestfold 10pkt Sor 2022
acquisitions.where: Grenland, the coast south of Porsgrunn

acquisitions.name: Larvik 10pkt 2010
acquisitions.note: Fifteen years under the 2025 Vestfold flight. The oldest 10 pkt in the country, and worth holding for what has been built over since.

acquisitions.name: Viken 2022 - Østfold 10pkt
acquisitions.where: Østfold, Glomma to the Swedish border

acquisitions.name: Vest-Telemark Nordre 10pkt 2025
acquisitions.where: Vest-Telemark, Haukeli and the Hardangervidda edge

acquisitions.name: NDH Lillesand-Grimstad-Arendal 10pkt 2023
acquisitions.where: Agder, the coast from Lillesand to Arendal

acquisitions.name: Vestfold og Telemark 5pkt 2021
acquisitions.note: The store's first acquisition. Last in the queue now, not first: it is the sparsest flight on this list, and the 2025 Vestfold one covers its eastern half at twice the density.
